practice.intro: Ten questions a day, picked for you. What you get wrong comes back until you get it right.
practice.english: Questions are in English, the language placement tests use.
practice.noRunner: Coding is practised here by predicting output and choosing answers. Running your own code is not switched on for this college yet.
practice.mineWaiting_one: {{count}} question you wrote is waiting for a faculty review.
practice.mineWaiting_other: {{count}} questions you wrote are waiting for a faculty review.

today.title: Today's practice
today.body_one: {{count}} question, about two minutes. Mistakes from earlier days come first.
today.body_other: {{count}} questions, about fifteen minutes. Mistakes from earlier days come first.
today.done: Done for today. Come back tomorrow.

topics.title: How you are doing by topic
topics.intro: From your answers in the last 90 days. Topics below 60% come back more often.
topics.emptyBody: Finish today's set and your topics show up here.

companies.title: Preparing for a company
companies.intro_one: Questions faculty tagged for companies that recruit here. You can do {{count}} more company set today.
companies.intro_other: Questions faculty tagged for companies that recruit here. You can do {{count}} more company sets today.
companies.noneLeft: You have done all of today's company sets. More tomorrow.
companies.emptyBody: When faculty tag questions for a company that visits the college, you can practise for it here.

set.outputHint: Exactly what the program prints, line by line.
set.codeHint: Read from standard input and print to standard output.
set.missedBack: The ones you missed come back tomorrow, so they stick.

form.bodyReviewer: It goes into the bank straight away. Write your own question: never copy one from a company paper, book or website.
form.bodyAlumni: A faculty member checks it before students see it. Write your own question: never copy one from a company paper, book or website.
form.question: Question
form.questionHint: Clear and complete, so a student can answer without asking anything.
form.codeHint: A short program shown with the question.
form.codingNote: Students write a program. It is checked against the tests below on the college's code runner.
form.optionsHint: Select the right one. The wrong ones should be mistakes students really make.
form.testsHint: Each test gives an input and the output a correct program prints. Students do not see them.
form.explanationHint: How to get the answer, in a few short sentences. Students see it after answering.
form.companiesHint: Companies that recruit at the college. Press Enter after each.

problem.options: Give at least two different options.
problem.answer: Give the right answer: select an option, or write the number or the output.
problem.code: Add the code whose output is asked for.
problem.tests: Add at least one test with its expected output.

form.sentForReview: Sent. A faculty member will review it.

bank.intro: The college's practice questions. Questions from alumni and AI drafts wait here until a faculty member approves them. Tag questions with the companies that recruit here so students can prepare for them.
bank.draftBody: The AI writes new questions for a topic. Check every answer before you approve one: drafts can be wrong.

draftUnavailable.not_configured: AI is not set up for this college.
draftUnavailable.budget: This month's AI budget is used up.
draftUnavailable.daily_limit: You have used today's AI drafts. Try tomorrow.
draftUnavailable.unavailable: The AI is not available right now. Try again later.
draftUnavailable.invalid_output: The AI's drafts could not be used. Try again.

mastery.intro: How each batch is doing by topic, from answers since {{date}}. Use it to plan training sessions.
mastery.table: Accuracy by topic for this batch
mastery.suppressed: Groups of fewer than five show as “<5”, without accuracy, so no one can be singled out.
